definitions.cap: frozen raw cap C with s<=C
definitions.p_x_q_x: positive/negative clause-incidence counts for pivot x

theorem.name: BOUNDED_WIDTH_LOW_INCIDENCE_PIVOT_IS_RAW_CAP_SAFE
theorem.statement: For any live pivot x, if one polarity is absent then elimination is pure deletion and fits whenever s<=C. Otherwise, with d=d_x and maximum clause width w, the generic raw bound satisfies B_x <= s-(w+1)d+(2w-1)d^2/4. Hence every pivot with d<=D_w(Delta) is guaranteed to fit, where D_w(Delta)=2*((w+1)+sqrt((w+1)^2+(2w-1)*Delta))/(2w-1).
proof: Because q-1 and p-1 are nonnegative, B_x<=s+p*q-2d+(w-1)(2p*q-d)=s-(w+1)d+(2w-1)p*q.
The positive root of ((2w-1)/4)d^2-(w+1)d-Delta=0 is D_w(Delta). For 0<=d<=D_w(Delta), the displayed upper bound is <=C, so the generic raw-budget lemma certifies exact capped elimination.
If p=0 or q=0, no cross-product exists; elimination only removes pivot clauses and is cap-safe directly.

corollary.name: AVERAGE_DEGREE_FORCES_A_SAFE_PIVOT
corollary.statement: Since sum_x d_x=L, some live variable has d_x<=L/n. Therefore L/n<=D_w(Delta) implies existence of at least one ordinary exact capped pivot.
corollary.contrapositive_pressure: If every live pivot truly overflows the cap, then necessarily d_x>D_w(Delta) for every x and L>n*D_w(Delta).

interpretation: Three frozen width-3 probe rungs are theorem-level incapable of reaching the all-pivot-overflow filter. Only the 4-variable/10-clause/N=9 rung remains potentially capable of exercising the v3 tail under this sufficient analysis.
next_exact_target: Analyze the sole uncertified frozen width-3 rung or use the degree-pressure inequality to construct a sharper adversary at larger width/depth.
